claim_adjudication.critique_1_claim: Trailing P/E 12.88x-12.90x; price SAR 61.30; TTM EPS SAR 4.76; market cap SAR 47,048mn on 767.5mn shares.
claim_adjudication.verdict: CONFIRMED. Every figure reproduces from the issuer's own filings. Price SAR 61.30 is the correct 6-Aug-2026 close. TTM EPS SAR 4.76 is exactly 4.51 + 2.32 - 2.07. Market cap 47,048mn is exactly 61.30 x 767.5mn.
claim_adjudication.internal_inconsistency_resolved: The '767.5mn vs 3,650mn' tension the tasking flagged is a LABELLING error in the critique's prose, not an arithmetic error, and NEITHER route is wrong. 767.5mn is the weighted-average SHARE COUNT disclosed in Mobily's H1-2026 filing. 3,650 is the TTM NET INCOME IN SAR MILLIONS (3,466 + 1,781 - 1,597 = 3,650), not a share count. Both numbers are correct and both belong in the calculation - one as the denominator of the per-share route, one as the denominator of the market-cap route. They are not two rival share counts.

A live aggregator checked on 17-Aug-2026 reads 13.41x at SAR 63.55 on EPS TTM 4.75 - consistent with ~12.9x at SAR 61.30, not with 14.0x-15.6x. EAND.company: Emirates Telecommunications Group Company PJSC (e&, formerly Etisalat)
EAND.price_note: CONFIRMED BY TWO INDEPENDENT PROVIDERS agreeing to the fil on the whole early-August series: 3-Aug 20.30, 4-Aug 21.00, 5-Aug 21.00, 6-Aug 20.98, 7-Aug 20.50. 52-week range 17.40-21.60. NO SESSION IN THIS WINDOW CLOSED AT AED 20.70.
EAND.shares_note: 8,696.75mn confirmed three ways by back-solving the issuer's own disclosed EPS against its own disclosed net profit (see arithmetic_detail.eps_crosscheck), and corroborated by a provider quote page showing 8.70bn.
EAND.eps_basis: REPORTED net profit attributable to owners of the company, trailing twelve months = FY2025 + H1-2026 - H1-2025, all three legs on a REPORTED (NOT normalised) basis. See eps_basis_warning - this distinction is load-bearing for e&.
EAND.eps_basis_warning: e& carries large one-off and associate items and its own releases quote BOTH bases, so the bridge must not mix them. (1) The H1-2026 release quotes the H1-2025 comparative EPS as AED 0.67 ADJUSTED - i.e. stripped of the Khazna disposal gain and the Maroc Telecom settlement. Using that adjusted comparative in the bridge (1.65 + 0.69 - 0.67 = 1.67) IS WRONG, because FY2025's reported 1.65 still CONTAINS those same one-offs; subtracting an adjusted figure leaves them double-counted inside the trailing window. The correct bridge subtracts the REPORTED H1-2025 EPS of AED 1.01. (2) Because those H1-2025 one-offs sit in the SUBTRACTED leg, this TTM is simultaneously reported-basis AND effectively free of the Khazna gain and the MT settlement - they have rolled out of the window. (3) The Vodafone stake disposal (AED 21.9bn cash proceeds, AED 4.8bn net cash gain) COMPLETED IN JULY 2026 = Q3-2026, so it is NOT in H1-2026 and NOT in this TTM. It will inflate reported TTM EPS from Q3-2026 onward and depress the apparent P/E - a forward audit trap. (4) H1-2026 figures exclude Careem Technologies following deconsolidation after a partial sale.
EAND.dps_basis: Declared basis, trailing twelve months to the anchor: 47.0 fils H2-2025 dividend (proposed with FY2025 results, 24-Feb-2026) + 47.5 fils H1-2026 interim (declared 30-Jul-2026, +10.5% YoY) = 94.5 fils = AED 0.945. e& guided total 2026 DPS of 95 fils versus 90 fils for full-year 2025.

arithmetic_detail.eps_crosscheck: Each disclosed EPS divides its disclosed net profit into the SAME share count, proving all three legs are attributable-to-owners (not total incl. NCI) and confirming the denominator: 14.4bn / 8,696.75mn = 1.656 ~ 1.65 OK; 6.0bn / 8,696.75mn = 0.690 ~ 0.69 OK; 8.8bn / 8,696.75mn = 1.012 ~ 1.01 OK.
arithmetic_detail.independent_corroboration: A provider quote page on 17-Aug-2026 independently shows EPS TTM 1.33, Net Income TTM AED 11.54bn, shares 8.70bn, trailing P/E 15.76 at AED 21.18, DPS 0.95, yield 4.50% - reproducing the entire build from a separate data path. Their slightly more precise TTM net income of 11.54bn (vs 11.6bn from the issuer's rounded AED-billion disclosures) gives EPS 1.327 and a 6-Aug P/E of 15.81x, so the honest statement of e&'s trailing P/E at the anchor is 15.7x-15.8x.

claim_adjudication.critique_eps_verdict: CONFIRMED EXACTLY. 1.65 + 0.69 - 1.01 = 1.33 on a reported attributable basis, and 11.6bn / 8,696.75mn = 1.334 by the market-cap route. Independently corroborated.
claim_adjudication.critique_price_verdict: WRONG DATE. AED 20.50 is the 7-Aug-2026 close. The 6-Aug-2026 close was AED 20.98. Since the tasking anchors on 6-Aug, 20.98 is the correct price.
claim_adjudication.critique_pe_verdict: SLIGHTLY LOW for the 6-Aug anchor, because it prices off the 7-Aug close. Correct: 15.7x-15.8x at 6-Aug (AED 20.98); 15.4x at 7-Aug (AED 20.50). The critique's range is right for its own price but mislabelled as to date.
claim_adjudication.critique_transcription_allegation: The study's 20.7x is actually e&'s share price of AED 20.70 on 6-Aug-2026, mistranscribed as a multiple.
claim_adjudication.critique_transcription_verdict: NOT CORROBORATED - the specific diagnosis fails on the price record. e& did NOT close at AED 20.70 on 6-Aug-2026 (it closed at 20.98) nor on 7-Aug (20.50), and no session in the 3-7 Aug window printed a 20.70 close (20.30 / 21.00 / 21.00 / 20.98 / 20.50). Two independent providers agree on that series. So the alleged source number AED 20.70 does not exist as a closing price at the anchor, and the transcription theory is unproven. HOWEVER the critique's UNDERLYING POINT SURVIVES INDEPENDENTLY: the study's 20.7x is not supportable from filed numbers on any basis. A 20.7x multiple on TTM EPS of AED 1.33 implies a price of AED 27.5-27.6 (20.7 x 1.3338 = 27.61), which is far outside e&'s 52-week range of 17.40-21.60. The filed-numbers trailing P/E is ~15.7x. So the 20.7x figure is wrong by roughly 5 turns regardless of how it arose - the error is established, its cause is not.

headline_findings: MOBILY: the 12.88x-12.90x critique is CONFIRMED from Mobily's own Saudi Exchange filings. TTM EPS SAR 4.76 = 4.51 + 2.32 - 2.07; P/E = 61.30 / 4.76 = 12.88x; market-cap route 47,048 / 3,650 = 12.89x. Both routes reconcile.

MOBILY: the flagged '767.5mn vs 3,650mn' inconsistency is NOT a numerical error. 767.5mn is the H1-2026 filing's weighted-average share count; 3,650 is TTM net income in SAR millions. Both are correct inputs to different routes of the same calculation. Neither route is wrong.

MOBILY: the rival '14.0x-15.6x aggregator' claim does NOT reproduce from filed numbers (which give 12.88x-12.93x). A stale FY2024 EPS of 4.03 would give 15.21x, inside that band - offered as an unverified hypothesis for the discrepancy, not as a sourced finding.
EAND: the critique's TTM EPS of AED 1.33 is CONFIRMED EXACTLY on a reported attributable basis (1.65 + 0.69 - 1.01).
EAND: the critique's price of AED 20.50 is the 7-AUG close, not 6-Aug. The 6-Aug-2026 close was AED 20.98, giving a trailing P/E of 15.7x-15.8x rather than the critique's 15.3x-15.6x.

EAND: the allegation that the study's 20.7x is the 6-Aug share price 'AED 20.70' mistranscribed is NOT CORROBORATED - e& closed at 20.98 on 6-Aug and 20.50 on 7-Aug, and no session in 3-7 Aug closed at 20.70 (20.30 / 21.00 / 21.00 / 20.98 / 20.50), per two independent providers agreeing to the fil. The critique's CONCLUSION nonetheless holds by an independent route: 20.7x is unsupportable on filed numbers, since 20.7x on EPS 1.33 implies AED 27.5-27.6, far outside the 52-week range of 17.40-21.60. The study's error is established; its cause is not.

EAND: the reported-vs-normalised distinction is the single biggest trap in this comparison. e&'s own H1-2026 release quotes the H1-2025 comparative on an ADJUSTED basis (EPS 0.67). Substituting that into the TTM bridge yields a spurious 1.67 and a P/E of ~12.6x, because FY2025's reported 1.65 still contains the same Khazna and Maroc Telecom one-offs. Any critique or study quoting an e& P/E near 12-13x should be checked for exactly this mixed-basis error.

methodological_flags_for_the_audit: TTM CONSTRUCTION: all TTM figures here use FY + H1(current) - H1(prior), as instructed. This is a legitimate trailing construction but it is NOT the same as summing four actual quarters, and for issuers reporting only semi-annually it is the only option. State the method in the study.

SHARE-COUNT CONVENTION: Mobily has three defensible share counts (767.5mn H1-2026 weighted average, 769.05mn FY2025 weighted average, 770.0mn issued). The P/E only moves 12.88x to 12.93x across them, so the choice is immaterial here - but the study should state which it uses, since the critiques' apparent disagreement partly traces to this.

BASIS CONSISTENCY IS THE BINDING CONSTRAINT, NOT PRECISION. Both critiques' arithmetic is broadly sound; the disagreements trace to (a) which DATE the price is taken from, and (b) whether the subtracted prior-period leg is REPORTED or ADJUSTED. Resolve those two and the numbers converge.

PEER-SET INDEPENDENCE: Omantel holds ~21.9% of Zain, so those two are not independent observations and should not both enter a peer median. Any peer multiple set spanning both double-counts the same earnings stream.

FORWARD TRAP ON e&: the Vodafone disposal (AED 21.9bn proceeds, AED 4.8bn net cash gain) completed in JULY 2026 = Q3-2026. It is outside this TTM window but will enter from Q3-2026, inflating reported TTM EPS and depressing the apparent trailing P/E. Any later re-derivation of e&'s trailing P/E must normalise for it or the peer comparison will silently break.
NO RATING OR PRICE TARGET is expressed or implied anywhere in this file. Analyst consensus figures encountered on provider pages were deliberately NOT carried into the dataset.
